summary.value: The Wallace Hotel offers the ultimate luxury and sophistication on the Upper West Side of New York City, a short walk from Lincoln Center and Central Park. It is a newer property (“Clean, nice spot. Opened in 2020”) that suits couples wanting comfort uptown; guests say “The room was very spacious, and the bed was super comfortable”. Honest watch-out: one guest found “It was noisy continuously throughout the night”.

description.value: The Wallace Hotel is a luxury hotel on the Upper West Side. The hotel says it offers the ultimate luxury and sophistication on the Upper West Side of New York City. It is a short walk to Lincoln Center, Central Park and the Broadway subway lines. Representative Trip.com praise (guest reviews): “The room was very spacious, and the bed was super comfortable”; “Clean, nice spot. Opened in 2020”. Representative watch-outs: “It was noisy continuously throughout the night”.
